prompt: Epic orchestral score at 64 BPM in D minor: aliens arriving, a battle of wills rather than arms; fear in the low half, hope in the high half, both at once in the climaxes

requests.ask: add a new song: an epic motion picture score, very large and orchestral, aliens coming to earth, not a battle but an emotional battle of will, lots of instruments, designed not chaotic, fear and hope at once

changes.why: bpm 64, D minor, seed 41: slow enough for one bar per cycle to read as a film cue
handchimes with follow off and a fixed 0 6 3 line: the alien signal never moves with the harmony
steinway theme rising by step to the seventh (a question), brightness ramping .3>.55 over the section
climax on i VI III VII: pedal organ bass, strings, quiet organ, accordion choir, chimes, tubular bells, harp arpeggio, recorder held tones, impact on the downbeat
D phrygian i II: didgeridoo bass, theme shrunk to a half-step sigh, chimes and bells louder: the alien will against the human one
F major I V vi IV: harp and recorders join, brightness ramps .45>.8, riser into the threshold
the answered theme ending on the root at level 1.2 over a low loud organ and a full bass: hope over fear on the same chords
timpani, bass drum, gong, cymbal swells, heartbeat frame drum, wind and space beds outside the layers, per section
